"""Adapt fixed unchanged quality design to the accounted cache continuation."""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
training=read(root/'plan-v2.json');guard(training)
old=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post=root/'postprocess-v2/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for p in old.glob('*.py'):
    text=p.read_text()
    if p.name in ['review_paired_response_trial.py','score_paired_response_trial.py','audit_paired_response_trial.py','render_paired_response_trial.py']:
        text=text.replace('"plan-v1.json"','"plan-v2.json"').replace('"status-v1.json"','"status-v2.json"')
        text=text.replace('"postprocess-plan-v1.json"','"postprocess-plan-v2.json"')
        text=text.replace('"cache-result-v1.json"','"cache-result-v2.json"')
    if p.name=='review_paired_response_trial.py':
        text=text.replace('{"parent_root": 990, "DINO": 990}','{"parent_root": 977, "DINO": 977}')
        needle='    assert cache["counts"] == {"parent_root": 977, "DINO": 977}'
        assert needle in text
        text=text.replace(needle,needle+'''
    assert cache["adopted_parent_batches"] == 23
    failed = read(root / "cache-failure-v1.json")
    assert failed["progress"]["counts"] == {"parent_root":13,"DINO":13}
    adoption=read(root / "cache-adoption-v2.json")
    assert cache["batches"][:23]==adoption["batches"]
    assert 10+13+977==len(cache["batches"])==1000''')
    compile(text,str(p),'exec');(post/p.name).write_text(text)
pref=read(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json')
cmd=pref['command']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(training['work'])/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',cmd],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v2.json',dict(pref,recorded_unix_UTC=time.time(),
    returncode=run.returncode,stdout=run.stdout,stderr=run.stderr,
    sources={str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},
    source=dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    scope='Same four fixed endpoints/822 cases/48 board templates/five retained comparators as original pre-quality design. Only plan/status/cache result routes and exact977 continuation accounting changed. No model or quality-dependent selection.'))
queue=(repo/'.cache/queue-v160-review-v1.py').read_text()
queue=queue.replace('plan-v1.json','plan-v2.json').replace('launch-v1.json','launch-v2.json')
queue=queue.replace('postprocess-import-preflight-v1','postprocess-import-preflight-v2')
queue=queue.replace('postprocess-v1','postprocess-v2')
queue=queue.replace('postprocess-plan-v1','postprocess-plan-v2')
queue=queue.replace('postprocess-controller.claim','postprocess-controller-v2.claim')
queue=queue.replace('postprocess-status-v1','postprocess-status-v2').replace('status-v1.json','status-v2.json')
queue=queue.replace("{'parity','prefix','smoke','cache','train'}","{'cache','train'}")
queue=queue.replace("stage+'-v1.log'","stage+'-v2.log'")
path=repo/'.cache/queue-v160-review-v2.py';assert not path.exists();path.write_text(queue)
with (root/'postprocess-controller-v2.log').open('x') as log:
    process=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(path)],cwd=repo,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='src:scripts'),
        stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
    owner={'pid':process.pid,'created':__import__('psutil').Process(process.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'postprocess-launch-v2.json',{'owner':owner,'source':ref(path),'preflight':ref(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v2.json')})
print(run.stdout.strip());print('Fixed review queue follows continuation owner',owner)
